notes: No data dictionary, schema, or entity/field documentation exists in any artifact. The vendor's entire EHI export documentation is a single 1-page PDF (111 words) that describes two export formats (JSON for single patient, .bak for population) without any structural detail about the data contained in either format. The FHIR API documentation at fhir.10e11.com documents the (g)(10) API, not the (b)(10) EHI export, and lists USCDI v1 FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Procedure, Observation, MedicationRequest, AllergyIntolerance, Immunization, CarePlan, CareTeam, Goal, DocumentReference, DiagnosticReport, Encounter, Device, Location, Organization, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Provenance, ClinicalImpression, Binary, Group) but these are standard US Core profiles, not vendor-specific data model documentation.
